UTILITY A · FOR QUESTIONS
The first setup prompt, in full
Help me create a recurring website-monitoring job.
Assume I have never configured a Hermes job before. Ask me for the required details one question at a time, explain unfamiliar options briefly, and recommend sensible defaults.
If I do not know something—such as the website URLs—help me find it.
The job should: monitor online shop websites; compare them with a baseline; identify meaningful commercial changes; send a sourced briefing to this Discord channel.
Once you have gathered everything, show me the proposed configuration and ask for confirmation. Do not create or run the job until I approve it.
Start with the first question.
